cases.name: Jeanette Lisa Pfleger
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Jeanette was a beloved mother, grandmother, and friend. 

Described as the most sweetest and caring person, Jeanette had a deep love for her family and friends. She would have done anything she could for any of them. Her kindness and compassion touched the lives of many."
